d:
Very long, straight midnight black hair with sharp bangs and a glossy texture. Intense, narrow deep violet eyes with a piercing gaze. Apparent age of a mature adult. Tall, slender, and poised build. A sophisticated black and deep red military dress with ornate gold trim and a long flowing cape. Long, pointed black fox ears and a massive, bushy white and black fox tail.
BODY COLOR: pale porcelain
